fnol_text: My name is Elena Vasquez and I live at 926 Primrose Terrace, Springfield, OH 45553. You can reach me on (555) 904-3823 or elena.vasquez@example.com. On 7 June 2026 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Dmitri Whitlock, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2023-00093. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Vasquez on (555) 904-3823 to acknowledge the claim. Elena confirmed the loss date as 7 June 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Fatima Novak gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Dmitri Whitlock reports bruised ribs and attended Mercy General. Elena reports a sprained wrist.
